name: Dev Tools
description: Runs offline in a sandbox with zero network calls. 48 developer utilities in under 200KB: an all-in-one toolkit covering crypto & security, encoding, text & regex, time & Cron, network & DevOps, and frontend assets — built for everyday development needs.
releaseNotes: 修复：Cron 的 N/step 步长解析（如 0/2 不再退化为整点），非法 ?/N 会被拒绝。新增：下次执行条数可自定义并记忆；首页 GitHub 图标加入动画（空闲微摆 + 悬停变色），页脚新增开源反馈入口，复制链接改为跟随点击位置的浮层提示。 | Fix: cron N/step atoms (e.g. 0/2) no longer degrade to the bare start value, and invalid ?/N is rejected. New: configurable next-runs count (persisted); animated GitHub icon with idle tail-flick and brand-teal hover, plus a footer invite for issues/PRs/stars; copy confirmation is now a floating chip at the click point.

zh-CN.name: Dev 工具集
zh-CN.description: 沙箱离线运行，零联网。48 款开发工具小于 200KB：集安全加解密、编解码与转义、文本与正则排版、时间与 Cron 计算、网络与系统运维、前端图像与标识生成等全场景工具于一体，满足日常开发高频需求。
